Splitting the review artifacts into a predecessor commit would leave the ledger commit missing four declared paths and the verifier would reject it. The tooling is the enforcer and is being followed: one commit carries the TASK-20260802-103 and TASK-20260802-104 review artifacts together with EV-MLKEM-017, DEC-20260802-15cadd, GOAL-MLKEM-003 and this receipt.
handoff_constraint_deviation.evidence_integrity_consequence: None adverse. The review artifacts still become durable in the same act that makes the decision durable, and the verifier still binds every declared path and hash to a reachable commit with the expected parent. The one rule that cares about ordering here -- docs/claims-and-verification.md, refutation artifact archived before the decision relying on it -- is not engaged, because DEC-20260802-15cadd makes no adverse transition (no weaken, no reject_scoped, no hypothesis moved to rejected).
